(CONT'D. BELOW)

(CONT'D. FROM ABOVE) SPECIFICALLY THE TERMS OF THE WRITTEN SETTLEMENT ARE (1)BACK RENT FOR MAY, JUNE & JULY OF $2028 WAS PAID AND RECEIPT THEREFORE ACKNOWLEDGED. DEFT IS TO PAY ATTY FEES OF $550 & COSTS OF $136 A TOTAL OF $686 AT THE RATE OF $50 PER MONTH BEGINNING ON AUGUST 15, 2000 & THEREAFTER ON THE 15TH OF EACH MONTH UNTIL PAID IN FULL. IN THE EVENT DEFT FAILS TO MAKE ANY OF SUCH PAYMENTS THEN LANDLORD MAY APPLY EXPARTE FOR A JUDGMENT FOR OUTSTANDING ATTY FEES, & COSTS & POSSESSION. (CONT'D. BELOW)

(CONT'D. FROM ABOVE) IN LIGHT OF THE COURT FINDING AS TO WHAT CONSTITUTES THE WRITTEN SETTLEMENT THE COURT REJECTS THE CLAIM OF FRAUD IN INDUCING THE SIGNING OF THE WRITTEN SETTLEMENT STIPULATION BECAUSE THE COURT IS ONLY ENFORCING THE WRITTEN SETTLEMENT STIPULATION TO THE EXTENT OF WHAT WAS EXPRESSLY STATED ON THE RECORD IN OPEN COURT WHEN DEFT & HIS COUNSEL WERE PRESENT. PLTF HAS INTRODUCED EVIDENCE THAT THE PAYMENTS OF $50 WERE NOT MADE AS AGREED ACCORDINGLY PLTF IS ENTITLED TO JUDGMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF (CONT'D. BELOW)
(CONT'D. FROM ABOVE) UNPAID ATTYS FEES AND COSTS AND FOR POSSESSION. PLTF IS TO PREPARE A FINAL ORDER AND JUDGMENT IN ACCORDANCE WITH THIS RULING.
